title: Prove paid rank eight optimal for the four-call clean query contract
body:
For six formal query targets over any characteristic-two field, prove total paid rank eight is minimal with at most four square-zero calls of rank at most two, arbitrary constant free bases and any finite initialized-clean helpers returned zero. The endpoint is the complete clean-column contract W(x,0)=(Qx,0); helper input columns remain unspecified.

The new implication is the fixed-subspace extension of Nick Petalas #6800's credited projection/rank-factorization argument: if M=sum N_i fixes a d-dimensional space and N_i²=0, then S=sum rank(N_i) ≥ d+max rank(N_i). Actual I+QN calls normalize through I+QN=(I+N)(I+(1+Q)N). No projection assumption is imposed on M. Existing #6808 supplies attainment and helper minimality; neither is replayed or recounted. The four-call cap is essential: #6800/#6138 already give six targets with seven rank-one workspace-free calls, total seven.

Exhaustive bounded rank-factor checks cover 23,998 ordered two-role square-zero sums over F2/F3/F5; three rank-two block fixtures; 54 new tiny F2 normalization words/270 instruction steps; 81 padded rank profiles; four mathematical controls, one legal-zero-padding counting convention and three parser controls. Final normal and optimized complete packets agree (26,723 bytes, SHA256 e913efb71bbeda6694cce9395b295967d2e13b66a750a91db6251a993d177e87). Four inert exact predecessor prose files are locally authenticated. No predecessor engine or eight-role attaining word runs. Registered replay and committed source-history/mode preflight pass. Read-only Git-free empty-PATH export replays match the whole packet in both modes. Ten isolated source/typed-False-to-0 corruptions reject for their intended reasons under normal/O. These are finite checks; this is a finite certificate plus written proof, not human/kernel acceptance.

Only research/clean-query-rank-optimum is added. No dependency, shared code, selected frontier or κ change. Changed/partial bit-new-register-model task; native caller, helper preparation, basis implementation, routing/chronology, precision/stock/restoration and complete physical recursive invoice remain unknown. All five selected assumptions remain. No broader construction/classification reserved.
